name: GitHub
description: Manage repositories, create branches, pull requests, issues, and more via the GitHub API
author: Synapse

fields.label: GitHub App ID
fields.hint: Machine-level credential. Never stored on a profile or exported.

fields.label: Installation ID
fields.hint: Machine-level credential. Never stored on a profile or exported.

fields.label: Private key (PEM)
fields.hint: Machine-level secret. Never stored on a profile or exported.

fields.label: Allowed repositories
fields.hint: owner/repo entries. When empty, every repository the App can reach is allowed.

fields.label: Co-author name
fields.hint: Added to commit messages as a Co-authored-by trailer.

fields.label: Co-author email
fields.hint: Required together with the co-author name.
